environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on ECS Fargate with a task role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/OrderServiceRole) that has dynamodb:Query permission on table 'multi_tenant_orders' with no IAM condition keys. The table has a partition key 'tenant_id' and sort key 'order_date'. The role policy allows querying any item in the table regardless of attribute values. No VPC endpoint policy restrictions. Service is behind an ALB with no WAF attached.

config.network: public ALB, no VPC endpoint policy
